200.description:
Weekly fantasy projections for one position from GET startwho.com/api/projections: each player's projected points in the requested scoring, opponent and kickoff, and the sportsbook prop markets behind the number (consensus line, odds, implied value, points contributed, and every sportsbook's line and over/under odds). Omit week for the current week. A week the site has no projections for (past weeks, or future weeks before lines open) is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `players` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bookmaker_points` | object[] | The projection recomputed from each sportsbook's own lines. |
| `game_kickoff_at` | string | Kickoff as ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `locked` | boolean | True once the game has started. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `opponent` | string | "vs NE" at home, "@ TB" away. |
| `player_id` | string | The site's player slug, for example josh-allen; team defenses use the team slug. |
| `position` | string | QB, RB, WR, TE, K or DST (team defense). |
| `projected_points` | number | Projected fantasy points in the requested scoring. |
| `props` | object[] |  |
| `team` | string | Full team name, for example Buffalo Bills. |
| `vegas_percent` | number | Share of the projection backed by sportsbook lines, 0 to 100. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
